editorial:
Ever wonder if your partner is hiding a wild secret? You will love the setup here, where Carolin and Niklas seem like the perfect couple living a quiet suburban life. Everything is great until Carolin's past literally knocks on the door. Her old partner in crime, Timo, shows up demanding hush money for all the robberies they did together years ago. The vibe is a mix of a tense crime thriller and a lighthearted comedy, making you feel the panic as Carolin tries to keep her secret from her clueless husband. It is a fun ride that asks how well you actually know the person sleeping next to you.

The acting is snappy and the twists keep you guessing about who is actually playing whom. While the plot is a bit predictable at times, the chemistry between the leads makes it work. If you want a breezy movie night, you should definitely check this out. It looks great if you can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but renting it on Apple TV is also a quick way to watch. For those who love keeping physical discs, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: The big twist is that Niklas isn't as innocent as he seems. Once he finds out about Carolin's criminal past through a private investigator, he doesn't get mad. Instead, he uses the information to his advantage. The couple eventually teams up to outsmart Timo and take the money. They turn the tables on the blackmailer, ensuring their secrets stay safe while securing a nice payday, proving they make a great team in crime.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies with a criminal twist.
